bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up this passively discovered Plant Monitor BLE device? Protocol v3 reports one raw 100 nF TSC reading for each zone every 30 seconds.

user.title: Select a plant monitor
user.description: Select a compatible Plant Monitor BLE device currently in Bluetooth range.

abort.already_configured: This plant monitor is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this plant monitor is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No compatible Plant Monitor BLE devices were found. Wait for the next advertising burst and try again.
abort.not_supported: The Bluetooth advertisement is not a supported Plant Monitor BLE protocol frame.

init.title: Soil-moisture calibration
init.description: Enter dry and wet counts for each zone. Calibration uses the firmware's fixed 100 nF TSC reading. Wet counts must be lower than dry counts.

error.invalid_calibration: Each dry count must be greater than its corresponding wet count. Counts must be between 1 and 65534.
